# Through-analysis timing and prepared-source read controls

This separate firstparty rustc_driver variant copies the exact independently accepted metadata-emission driver and leaves that parent source/image unchanged. A monotonic clock starts after the prepared source map is decoded and after the analysis_span_started event is flushed, immediately before the run_compiler invocation. The after_analysis callback records a checked u64 elapsed nanosecond interval and then continues metadata emission. Each text/binary FileLoader read emits the normalized path, observed mapped content length or null, binary indicator and preparedMapEntryPresent flag. These are private experimental observation records, not native source authentication, public event vocabulary or full read confinement. JSON string escaping covers quotes, backslashes, control characters and Unicode paths. Instrumentation and its stdout work are included in measured analysis time; process startup/map decoding/metadata emission after after_analysis are excluded. The timer observation does not redefine pure uninstrumented compiler performance.

Three final new firstparty controls/three compiler children pass. No repository/application/build script/proc macro executes; include_bytes is a compiler builtin. Complete arguments/events/diagnostics/source maps/metadata and owned Darwin wait4 records are retained.
